title: Daily briefing: What we know about Shamonda virus
title_zh: 每日简报：关于 Shamonda 病毒的已知情况
abstract: The death of an immunocompromised man in France has been attributed to a newly discovered virus. Plus, good news about a cancer vaccine for melanoma and ponder whether the way we draw molecules is a lie.
abstract_zh: 法国一名免疫功能低下患者死亡，其病因被归咎于一种新发现的病毒。此外，黑色素瘤癌疫苗传来好消息，并探讨我们绘制分子的方式是否是一种谎言。
